high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "ig_architectures," located in Long Island, NY. The post features a modern kitchen design with a minimalist aesthetic. Setting: The kitchen has a contemporary design with wooden cabinetry that covers most of the walls. The ceiling is made of horizontal wooden slats, adding texture and warmth to the space. There are two large windows with horizontal blinds, allowing natural light to filter into the room while maintaining privacy.
